blocks.zh: 第一節：適用範圍
blocks.en: Section 1: Scope

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) 的適用範圍，包括哪些產品類型和製造流程受到規範
blocks.en: Understand the scope of PIC/S Annex 1 (2022), including which product types and manufacturing processes it covers

blocks.zh: 掌握品質風險管理 (QRM) 在本附錄整體適用的重要性與方式
blocks.en: Grasp why quality risk management (QRM) applies across the whole annex, and how

blocks.zh: 了解本附錄的原則如何延伸適用於某些非無菌產品（如乳膏、軟膏、低生物負載生物中間體）
blocks.en: Understand how the principles of this annex can be extended to certain non-sterile products (such as creams, ointments and low bioburden biological intermediates)

blocks.zh: 明白當製造商選擇將無菌製造原則套用於非無菌產品時，應履行的文件記錄義務
blocks.en: Understand the documentation obligations a manufacturer must meet when it chooses to apply sterile manufacturing principles to non-sterile products

blocks.zh: 1  Scope — 適用範圍
blocks.en: 1  Scope

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Sterile Products（無菌產品）的範疇： 本節明確說明「無菌產品」涵蓋範圍極廣，不只是最終劑型（如注射液），還包括原料藥（active substance）、賦形劑（excipient）、主要包裝材料（primary packaging material）。這意味著，一家 CDMO 若只做無菌充填，其原料藥供應商也可能受到 Annex 1 的間接影響。
blocks.en: The scope of sterile products: This section makes clear that "sterile products" covers a very wide range. It is not limited to the finished dosage form (such as an injectable) but also includes active substances, excipients and primary packaging materials. This means that even a CDMO that only performs sterile filling may be indirectly affected by Annex 1 through its active substance suppliers.

blocks.zh: Quality Risk Management（品質風險管理，QRM）： QRM 是整份文件的底層邏輯。Annex 1 不在每個段落重複提及 QRM，而是預設所有決策都必須以風險管理思維為基礎。這代表法規查核時，稽查員會問「你如何評估風險？」而非僅確認你有沒有做到某個特定動作。
blocks.en: Quality Risk Management (QRM): QRM is the underlying logic of the whole document. Annex 1 does not repeat QRM in every paragraph; instead it assumes that every decision must be grounded in risk management thinking. In practice, an inspector will ask "How did you assess the risk?" rather than simply checking that you performed a particular action.

blocks.zh: 最低要求（Minimum Requirement）： 文中特別說明，所有數字限值（如微粒計數限值、環境監測頻率）均為最低要求，是從多年法規經驗中得出。企業可以且應該在 QRM 分析的基礎上訂定更嚴格的標準。
blocks.en: Minimum requirement: The text states specifically that all numerical limits (such as particle count limits and environmental monitoring frequencies) are minimum requirements, drawn from many years of regulatory experience. Companies can, and should, set stricter standards on the basis of their QRM analysis.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像一部「道路安全法規」——它規範了所有在道路上行駛的車輛（不管是轎車、大貨車還是機車），但同樣的安全駕駛原則（如靠右行駛、禮讓行人）也可以被腳踏車騎士自願遵守，只要他們有記錄自己選擇遵守哪些原則。
blocks.en: Imagine a set of "road safety regulations". They govern every vehicle on the road (cars, trucks and motorcycles alike), yet the same safe-driving principles (keeping to the correct side, giving way to pedestrians) can also be followed voluntarily by a cyclist, provided the cyclist records which principles they have chosen to follow.

blocks.zh: PIC/S Annex 1 的邏輯也是如此：法規是為無菌產品設計的，但乳膏（cream）、軟膏（ointment）等非無菌產品的廠商，如果想要借用這些原則來提升品質，歡迎使用——但前提是你必須書面記錄你選擇套用了哪些部分。
blocks.en: PIC/S Annex 1 works the same way. The rules are designed for sterile products, but manufacturers of non-sterile products such as creams and ointments are welcome to borrow these principles to raise quality, on the condition that they document in writing which parts they have chosen to apply.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 延伸適用的條件與風險： 對於選擇將 Annex 1 原則套用於非無菌產品的廠商，文件記錄義務（documentation obligation）是強制性的。稽查時，若宣稱遵循 Annex 1 但缺乏完整文件說明，反而可能引發查核缺失。
blocks.en: Conditions and risks of extended application: For manufacturers that choose to apply Annex 1 principles to non-sterile products, the documentation obligation is mandatory. During an inspection, claiming to follow Annex 1 without complete supporting documentation can actually lead to an inspection finding.

blocks.zh: QRM 的「隱形存在」： QRM 雖不在段落中明說，卻在所有稽查問題背後。 面對 FDA 或 PIC/S 查核時，「為什麼訂這個限值？」「如果超標你怎麼辦？」這些問題的答案都需要有 QRM 文件支撐。
blocks.en: The "invisible presence" of QRM: Although QRM is not spelled out in every paragraph, it sits behind every inspection question. When facing an FDA or PIC/S inspection, the answers to "Why did you set this limit?" and "What do you do if it is exceeded?" all need to be supported by QRM documentation.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 同時生產注射劑（sterile）與眼用軟膏（non-sterile）。管理層希望眼用軟膏的製程也引用 Annex 1 的潔淨室分級與環境監測要求，以強化客戶信心。
blocks.en: A CDMO produces both injectables (sterile) and ophthalmic ointments (non-sterile). Management wants the ophthalmic ointment process to also reference the Annex 1 cleanroom classification and environmental monitoring requirements, to strengthen customer confidence.

blocks.zh: 根據本節，這是被允許的——但必須：(1) 書面記錄選擇套用的具體原則；(2) 確認實際達到合規要求；(3) 在 PQS 文件中清楚說明適用範圍。若無此文件，反而可能在稽查中被認定「宣稱但未落實」。
blocks.en: Under this section, that is permitted, but the CDMO must: (1) document in writing the specific principles it has chosen to apply; (2) confirm that it actually meets the requirements; and (3) state the scope of application clearly in its PQS documents. Without this documentation, an inspector could conclude that the company "claimed compliance but did not implement it".

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) 的「QRM 適用於整份文件」這句話，在日常製造管理上有什麼具體意義？是否意味著每個操作 SOP 都需要附上風險評估文件？
blocks.en: PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) states that QRM applies throughout the whole document. What does this mean in day-to-day manufacturing management? Does it mean every operating SOP must be accompanied by a risk assessment document?

blocks.zh: 一家廠商若將 Annex 1 原則自願套用於低生物負載的生物中間體（low bioburden biological intermediates），稽查員最可能要求查閱哪些文件？
blocks.en: If a manufacturer voluntarily applies Annex 1 principles to low bioburden biological intermediates, which documents is an inspector most likely to ask to review?

blocks.zh: 法規要求的「最低限值」與廠商自行訂定的「行動限值（action limit）」有何不同？若你的行動限值比法規要求更嚴格，對稽查有什麼影響？
blocks.en: How does the "minimum limit" required by the regulation differ from a manufacturer's own "action limit"? If your action limit is stricter than the regulatory requirement, what is the impact on an inspection?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) 適用於所有無菌產品的製造，涵蓋原料藥、賦形劑、初級包材及最終劑型，技術形式從高度自動化到手工操作均包含在內
blocks.en: PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) applies to the manufacture of all sterile products, covering active substances, excipients, primary packaging materials and finished dosage forms, and includes technologies ranging from highly automated to manual operations.

blocks.zh: 品質風險管理 (QRM) 是整份 Annex 1 的隱性底層架構——所有決策、限值設定與偏差調查都必須以 QRM 思維支撐
blocks.en: Quality risk management (QRM) is the implicit underlying framework of the whole of Annex 1: all decisions, limit setting and deviation investigations must be supported by QRM thinking.

blocks.zh: 文件中所有數字限值均為「最低要求」，源自歷史法規經驗；廠商可設定更嚴格的內部標準，但不得低於法規規定
blocks.en: All numerical limits in the document are "minimum requirements" derived from historical regulatory experience; manufacturers may set stricter internal standards but must not go below the regulatory requirements.

blocks.zh: Annex 1 的原則可自願延伸套用於某些非無菌產品（如乳膏、軟膏），但廠商必須清楚書面記錄所套用的原則並確認達標
blocks.en: Annex 1 principles may be voluntarily extended to certain non-sterile products (such as creams and ointments), but the manufacturer must clearly document the principles applied and confirm that they are met.
